text:
Tess (PM): Quick bug: after dragging rules the simulator sometimes shows the old order. Repro: create 4 rules, move #4 to top, hit Run Simulator immediately. Seen in Canary + Stable.

Arjun (Eng): Repro'd. We're sampling DOM order for the simulator snapshot; sometimes React hasn't flushed the new order.

Nora (Design): Users in testing took this as "change didn't apply". We should avoid mismatch between list and simulator.

Ivy (A11y): Keyboard reorder also has stale announcements. Need explicit SR text: "Moved to position 1 of 4" and stable focus restore.

Arjun (Eng): Fix plan: 1) read order from canonical store after commit (not DOM), 2) add a tiny simulator loading shimmer + aria-live text, 3) show a tentative "position pill" while dragging (muted saved index + blue tentative pill), 4) optional auto-commit on drop behind flag.

Tess (PM): Good. Also update conflict copy: current "Conflict" is unhelpful. Show which rules and which field overlaps and a short suggestion. Example: "Rule conflict: 'geo=EU' overlaps with 'country=DE' in rule 'EU traffic'  consider narrowing or lower priority."

Nora (Design): I'll draft microcopy variants and a tooltip for the tentative pill: "Will become #1 on save". Also propose a small toast: "Simulator updated to new order" when done.

Ivy (A11y): Shimmer/toast must use aria-live=polite and error banners should focus into an error summary with a "Go to rule" link. Undo must be keyboard-accessible.

Arjun (Eng): I'll submit a small PR with store-based capture, shimmer + aria-live, tentative pill, SR announcements, and unit tests that mock update timing. Branch: https://git.internal/redwood/routing-editor/pull/501 (WIP).

InfraBot: CI kicked for build 2401.

Tess (PM): Thanks. Assigning to Arjun for the sprint. If anyone sees filters + canary + reorder oddness, drop examples here.

Nora (Design): Noted — also attaching updated highlight colors for dark mode (contrast fix).

Ivy (A11y): I'll run a quick contrast check and add acceptance notes.

Arjun (Eng): Will demo when PR is ready.
